question: Please help me find the names of top 5 players with the highest average runs per match in season 5, along with their batting averages.
sql:
WITH season5_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        b.striker AS player_id,
        bs.runs_scored
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    JOIN batsman_scored bs 
        ON b.match_id = bs.match_id 
        AND b.over_id = bs.over_id 
        AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id 
        AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    JOIN match m ON b.match_id = m.match_id
    WHERE m.season_id = 5
),
player_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        player_id,
        SUM(runs_scored) AS total_runs
    FROM season5_runs
    GROUP BY player_id
),
player_matches AS (
    SELECT 
        pm.player_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT pm.match_id) AS matches_played
    FROM player_match pm
    JOIN match m ON pm.match_id = m.match_id
    WHERE m.season_id = 5
    GROUP BY pm.player_id
),
player_dismissals AS (
    SELECT 
        wt.player_out AS player_id,
        COUNT(*) AS times_out
    FROM wicket_taken wt
    JOIN match m ON wt.match_id = m.match_id
    WHERE m.season_id = 5
    GROUP BY wt.player_out
)
SELECT 
    p.player_name,
    pr.total_runs,
    pm.matches_played,
    1.0 * pr.total_runs / pm.matches_played AS avg_runs_per_match,
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(pd.times_out, 0) > 0 THEN 1.0 * pr.total_runs / pd.times_out ELSE pr.total_runs END AS batting_average
FROM player_runs pr
JOIN player_matches pm ON pr.player_id = pm.player_id
JOIN player p ON pr.player_id = p.player_id
LEFT JOIN player_dismissals pd ON pr.player_id = pd.player_id
ORDER BY avg_runs_per_match DESC
LIMIT 5
